notablePrerequisites: All modes but "Abandon Ship" have been chosen for Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
easyPrerequisites: An opponent must control an enchantment.
description:
Cast Shifting Grift for its third spree cost by paying {1}{U}{U}, exchanging control of an enchantment an opponent controls and Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
At the beginning of that opponent's upkeep, they are forced to choose the "Abandon Ship" mode and lose the game.
